_note: The sample church's website (sample_church_seed.site_html): the site kit's 'bulletin' layout, filled with these words and facts. Grace Street Fellowship is made up: every phone is 555-01NN, every address is @example.org, the street and town are invented (ZIP 00000). Photos are licensed stock from Unsplash (Unsplash License, free to use; credit is asked for and given in the footer). Each one is loaded from static/sample_church/<name>.jpg and served at /assets/sample-church/<name>.jpg; a photo whose file is not there is simply left out, so the site renders whole with none. The files are added separately (2026-11-15: the parent session gets Kevin's OK first). Never download them in code.

contact.hours: Sunday worship 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM; Wednesday Bible study 7:00 PM; Friday youth night 7:00 PM; Saturday food pantry 9:00 AM

events.note: Groceries for anyone who needs them. Volunteers from 8:30.

events.title: Baptism Sunday
events.note: After the 11:00 service. Ask any pastor.

leaders.head: Pastor Jordan Daniels
leaders.body: Jordan has served Grace Street for eleven years. Ask him about the food pantry, his family's terrible board games, or anything on your mind.

album.headline: A glimpse of Sundays and the week

ceremony.line: There's a seat saved for you.
ceremony.sub: First time? We'll meet you at the door and show you around.

visit.headline: Plan a visit
visit.intro: Park on Grace Street or in the lot behind the building. Greeters at the main doors will show you the kids rooms and save you a seat.
visit.extra: Check in at the kids desk by the main doors.
steps: Come at 8:50 or 10:50 and park out back.
Check the kids in at the kids desk.
Grab a coffee and find a seat.

footer.line: A made-up sample church in the Solutionist System. Nothing here is real.
